Description: Functional MRI data acquired during the visual sequence mismatch detection (VISSEQ) task.
TaskDescription: Participants learned sequences of five objects presented at different locations on a circular grid. Each sequence was defined by predictable spatial and semantic transitions between objects. Following a delay, participants viewed a test sequence and judged whether it matched the studied sequence (old/new). Test sequences were either intact or contained object swaps (semantic mismatch), location swaps (spatial mismatch), or both, at either near or far mismatch distances.
Instructions: Participants were instructed to learn the sequence of items, paying attention to the objects and their location. After a brief delay, they were instructed to indicate whether the sequence was repeated (Old) or changed in any way (New), including a change to the object, location, or both.
